title: p1 - AI lies confidently
hook: Your AI is LYING to you

beats.say: Quick question. Has an AI ever lied to your face?
Lied? It just makes things up, and it sounds totally sure.
Wait, what? Why would it do that?
Because it predicts the next likely word. It does not look up facts.

panel.sub: fluent is not the same as true

beats.say: So a confident answer can still be totally wrong?
Yep. Lawyers have even been fined for filing fake case citations an AI invented.
Okay, so how do I stop getting fooled?
One, ask for sources. Two, check every number. Three, tell it to say I don't know.
Wow. That last one is so simple.
And if you are building an app with AI, use code A T 100 on Base forty four. Link in bio.
Now be honest. What is the dumbest thing an AI ever told you?

caption:
Your AI sounds sure even when it is wrong. 3 rules to stop getting fooled.
